title: MLLM-as-a-Judge for Image Safety without Human Labeling

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's token probability scores on multimodal queries (with image tokens) against text-only queries (without image tokens) to isolate and measure the influence of text training priors on safety judgments.

Comparing the model's token probability scores on original whole images against modified images where the central object has been removed using an open-vocabulary object detector, in order to evaluate the undue influence of background elements or visual co-occurrences.
